chapterInfo.content:
10
Wɔti Nyankopɔn apam mu
1Na wɔn a wɔsɔɔ ano ne: Amrado Nehemia, Hakalia ba, ne Sedekia, 2Seraia, Asaria, Yeremia, 3Pasur, Amaria, Malkia, 4Hatus, Sebania, Maluk, 5Harim, Meremot, Obadia, 6Daniel, Gineton, Baruk, 7Mesulam, Abia, Miyamin, 8Maasia, Bilgai, Semaia; yeinom ne asɔfoɔ no; 9ne Lewifoɔ: Asania ba Yesua, Binui a ɔfiri Henadad mma mu, Kadmiel, 10ne wɔn nuanom: Sebania, Hodia, Kelita, Pelaia, Hanan, 11Mika, Rehob, Hasabia, 12Sakur, Serebia, Sebania, 13Hodia, Bani, Beninu; 14#Esra 2.3; 2.6 ɔman no atitire: Paros, Pahat-Moab, Elam, Satu, Bani, 15Buni, Asgad, Bebai, 16Adoniya, Bigwai, Adin, 17Ater, Hesekia, Asur, 18Hodia, Hasum, Besai, 19Harif, Anatot, Nebai, 20Magpias, Mesulam, Hesir, 21Mesesabel, Sadok, Yadua, 22Pelatia, Hanan, Anaia, 23Hosea, Hanania, Hasub, 24Halohes, Pilha, Sobek, 25Rehum, Hasabna, Maaseia, 26Ahia, Hanan, Anan, 27Maluk, Harim, Baana.
28 # Esra 2.70 Na ɔman no nkaeɛ, asɔfoɔ, Lewifoɔ, apono ano ahwɛfoɔ, nnwontofoɔ, nsɔfokwaa ne wɔn a wɔtee wɔn ho firii nsase no so aman ho baa Nyankopɔn mmara ho no, wɔn yerenom, wɔn mmammarima ne wɔn mmammaa, animdefoɔ ne nhunumufoɔ nyinaa, 29wɔbataa wɔn nuanom a wɔwɔ din no ho, na wɔdomedomee wɔn ho na wɔkekaa ntam sɛ wɔbɛdi Nyankopɔn mmara a wɔnam Nyankopɔn akoa Mose so hyɛeɛ no so, na wɔbɛhwɛ na wɔayɛ AWURADE yɛn wura mmara nsɛm ne n’atemmudeɛ ne n’ahyɛdeɛ nyinaa; 30ne sɛ yɛremfa yɛn mmammaa mma asase no sofoɔ, nanso yɛremfa wɔn mmammaa mma yɛn mmammarima. 31#Neh 13.15-16; Amos 8.5 Na sɛ asase no sofoɔ de adetɔnneɛ anaa aduane biara ba bɛtɔn no homeda a, yɛrentɔ mfiri wɔn hɔ homeda anaa da kronkron biara mu. Na yɛbɛgya afe a ɛtɔ so nson no mu nnɔbaeɛ, na yɛrennan ka biara.
32Afei yɛhyɛ yɛn ho mmara sɛ, yɛde nnwetɛbena nkyɛmu mmiɛnsa mu baako bɛma daa afe, na wɔde ama yɛn Nyankopɔn fie som no; 33ama kyerɛ paanoo ne daa aduane afɔdeɛ ne daa hyeɛ afɔdeɛ, home nna deɛ, bosome foforɔ deɛ, ama afahyɛ ne akronkronneɛ ne bɔne ho afɔdeɛ, sɛ wɔmfa mpata mma Israel ne yɛn Nyankopɔn fie adwuma nyinaa. 34#Lew 6.12 Nanso yɛtwee nnyina ayɛyɛdeɛ ho ntonto, asɔfoɔ, Lewifoɔ ne ɔman no, sɛ wɔmfa mmra yɛn Nyankopɔn fie, sɛdeɛ yɛn mpanimfie teɛ, afe afe mu, berɛ a wɔahyehyɛ mu, na wɔasɔ no AWURADE yɛn Nyankopɔn afɔrebukyia no so, sɛdeɛ wɔatwerɛ no mmara no mu no. 35#Eks 23.19 Na yɛhyɛɛ sɛ yɛde yɛn asase so aduanekan ne nnua nyinaa aba a ɛdi kan bɛba AWURADE fie daa afe, 36#Eks 13.2 na yɛde yɛn mmammarima ne yɛn mmoa mmakan nso, sɛdeɛ wɔatwerɛ no mmara no mu no, ne yɛn anantwie ne yɛn nnwan mmakan bɛba yɛn Nyankopɔn fie de abrɛ asɔfoɔ a wɔsom yɛn Nyankopɔn fie no, 37#Num 18.21 na yɛde yɛn mmɔrekan ne yɛn mmasoɔ afɔrebɔdeɛ ne nnua nyinaa aba ne nsa ne ngo nso bɛba de abrɛ asɔfoɔ no, sɛ wɔmfa ngu yɛn Nyankopɔn fie mpia no mu, na yɛde yɛn asase so ntotosoɔ du du bɛma Lewifoɔ no, na Lewifoɔ no anya ntotosoɔ du du, nkuraaseɛ nyinaa mu. 38#Num 18.26, 28 Na ɔsɔfoɔ, Aaron ba, nka Lewifoɔ no ho berɛ a Lewifoɔ no regye ntotosoɔ du du no, na Lewifoɔ no mfa ntotosoɔ du du no mu deɛ ɛtɔ so du no mmra yɛn Nyankopɔn fie, na wɔmfa ngu adekoradan mpia no mu. 39Na Israelfoɔ ne Lewifoɔ no nyinaa mfa aduane ne nsa ne ngo mmasoɔ afɔrebɔdeɛ mmra mpia no mu, na ɛhɔ na kronkronbea nnwinneɛ ne asɔfoɔ a wɔsom ne apono ano ahwɛfoɔ ne nnwontofoɔ no wɔ; na yɛrennya yɛn Nyankopɔn fie no.

Na wɔn a wɔsɔɔ ano ne: Amrado Nehemia, Hakalia ba, ne Sedekia, Seraia, Asaria, Yeremia, Pasur, Amaria, Malkia, Hatus, Sebania, Maluk, Harim, Meremot, Obadia, Daniel, Gineton, Baruk, Mesulam, Abia, Miyamin, Maasia, Bilgai, Semaia; yeinom ne asɔfoɔ no; ne Lewifoɔ: Asania ba Yesua, Binui a ɔfiri Henadad mma mu, Kadmiel, ne wɔn nuanom: Sebania, Hodia, Kelita, Pelaia, Hanan, Mika, Rehob, Hasabia, Sakur, Serebia, Sebania, Hodia, Bani, Beninu; ɔman no atitire: Paros, Pahat-Moab, Elam, Satu, Bani, Buni, Asgad, Bebai, Adoniya, Bigwai, Adin, Ater, Hesekia, Asur, Hodia, Hasum, Besai, Harif, Anatot, Nebai, Magpias, Mesulam, Hesir, Mesesabel, Sadok, Yadua, Pelatia, Hanan, Anaia, Hosea, Hanania, Hasub, Halohes, Pilha, Sobek, Rehum, Hasabna, Maaseia, Ahia, Hanan, Anan, Maluk, Harim, Baana.
Na ɔman no nkaeɛ, asɔfoɔ, Lewifoɔ, apono ano ahwɛfoɔ, nnwontofoɔ, nsɔfokwaa ne wɔn a wɔtee wɔn ho firii nsase no so aman ho baa Nyankopɔn mmara ho no, wɔn yerenom, wɔn mmammarima ne wɔn mmammaa, animdefoɔ ne nhunumufoɔ nyinaa, wɔbataa wɔn nuanom a wɔwɔ din no ho, na wɔdomedomee wɔn ho na wɔkekaa ntam sɛ wɔbɛdi Nyankopɔn mmara a wɔnam Nyankopɔn akoa Mose so hyɛeɛ no so, na wɔbɛhwɛ na wɔayɛ AWURADE yɛn wura mmara nsɛm ne n’atemmudeɛ ne n’ahyɛdeɛ nyinaa; ne sɛ yɛremfa yɛn mmammaa mma asase no sofoɔ, nanso yɛremfa wɔn mmammaa mma yɛn mmammarima. Afei yɛhyɛ yɛn ho mmara sɛ, yɛde nnwetɛbena nkyɛmu mmiɛnsa mu baako bɛma daa afe, na wɔde ama yɛn Nyankopɔn fie som no; ama kyerɛ paanoo ne daa aduane afɔdeɛ ne daa hyeɛ afɔdeɛ, home nna deɛ, bosome foforɔ deɛ, ama afahyɛ ne akronkronneɛ ne bɔne ho afɔdeɛ, sɛ wɔmfa mpata mma Israel ne yɛn Nyankopɔn fie adwuma nyinaa. Nanso yɛtwee nnyina ayɛyɛdeɛ ho ntonto, asɔfoɔ, Lewifoɔ ne ɔman no, sɛ wɔmfa mmra yɛn Nyankopɔn fie, sɛdeɛ yɛn mpanimfie teɛ, afe afe mu, berɛ a wɔahyehyɛ mu, na wɔasɔ no AWURADE yɛn Nyankopɔn afɔrebukyia no so, sɛdeɛ wɔatwerɛ no mmara no mu no. Na yɛhyɛɛ sɛ yɛde yɛn asase so aduanekan ne nnua nyinaa aba a ɛdi kan bɛba AWURADE fie daa afe, na yɛde yɛn mmammarima ne yɛn mmoa mmakan nso, sɛdeɛ wɔatwerɛ no mmara no mu no, ne yɛn anantwie ne yɛn nnwan mmakan bɛba yɛn Nyankopɔn fie de abrɛ asɔfoɔ a wɔsom yɛn Nyankopɔn fie no, na yɛde yɛn mmɔrekan ne yɛn mmasoɔ afɔrebɔdeɛ ne nnua nyinaa aba ne nsa ne ngo nso bɛba de abrɛ asɔfoɔ no, sɛ wɔmfa ngu yɛn Nyankopɔn fie mpia no mu, na yɛde yɛn asase so ntotosoɔ du du bɛma Lewifoɔ no, na Lewifoɔ no anya ntotosoɔ du du, nkuraaseɛ nyinaa mu. Na ɔsɔfoɔ, Aaron ba, nka Lewifoɔ no ho berɛ a Lewifoɔ no regye ntotosoɔ du du no, na Lewifoɔ no mfa ntotosoɔ du du no mu deɛ ɛtɔ so du no mmra yɛn Nyankopɔn fie, na wɔmfa ngu adekoradan mpia no mu. Na Israelfoɔ ne Lewifoɔ no nyinaa mfa aduane ne nsa ne ngo mmasoɔ afɔrebɔdeɛ mmra mpia no mu, na ɛhɔ na kronkronbea nnwinneɛ ne asɔfoɔ a wɔsom ne apono ano ahwɛfoɔ ne nnwontofoɔ no wɔ; na yɛrennya yɛn Nyankopɔn fie no.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
